AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safe Handling of Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safe Handling of Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safe Handling of Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safe Handling of Animals.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.

15. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Selected Crop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Weed control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain General Crop Harvesting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
